messages:
Harper: Anyone up for a Retro + Steam LAN this Friday 7pm? I can bring a small CRT and my RetroArch box for chaos. :tv: 
Jules: CRT huh — this is going to be peak nerd. Ill bring PC + Steam (Rocket League + Lethal League).
Tara: Im in. Bringing Switch + Mario Kart and two extra controllers.
Luis: I have a Genesis pad + USB adapter and a weird keyboard controller that may or may not work. Also 2 long Cat6s.
Nadia: Love it. Can we keep it family-friendly? No 3am rage-posting. :grimacing:
Harper: Agreed. Start 19:00, end ~23:00. Ill handle chips. Someone fancy pizza duty?
Jules: I can order pizza. Any dietary restrictions?
Tara: Vegan option please. GF if possible.
Luis: Heads up Im bringing a small surge protector and an extra HDMI.
Jules: Poll: React :one: for tournament bracket, :two: for party rotations, :three: for casual free-play.
Tara: :two: party rotations please.
Luis: :one: if theres a silly prize.
Nadia: :three: casual works best for me.
Harper: OK lean party rotations, with a quick 4-player bracket at 21:00 for whoever wants in.
Tara: Quick logistics q: will the deploy window at 20:30 be an issue for noise?
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy Friday 20:30-21:00. Please avoid noisy infra ops during this window.
Harper: Good catch, well pause announcements and keep things chill during deploy.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Retro + Steam LAN Night" Friday 19:00 Office Common Room — Attendees: Harper, Jules, Tara, Luis, Nadia.
Jules: Pizza ordered (1 vegan, 1 GF request noted). Contribute $4 for pies?
Tara: Contributing.
Nadia: In. Also Ill bring extra power strips and a headphone splitter.
Luis: See you Friday  bringing the silly controller for exhibition matches.
Harper: Sweet. Ping me if youre bringing friends and want to be added to the invite. :video_game:
